name: Sacha Omon AI – Agentic AI SDR Agent for Website, WhatsApp & Phone with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
author: sachaomonai

sections.description:
Sacha Omon AI: We Sell For You.

Sacha answers, calls, qualifies, sells your offers, books meetings and follows up — 24/7, on every channel (website, WhatsApp, phone), in writing in 40+ languages (website chat and WhatsApp messages) and by voice.

Build your agentic AI SDR in 10 min by talking.

It is not a chatbot that just answers. It is an agent that qualifies, follows up and books meetings, on every channel, with one record per customer. One agent, omnichannel (website, WhatsApp, phone), with RAG: Sacha answers from your own products and services.

What is RAG?

RAG stands for Retrieval-Augmented Generation. In plain words: before she answers, Sacha looks up your own knowledge base (your website, your products and services, your FAQ and your documents), then answers with your information, not with generic AI answers.

  • Accurate answers: Sacha answers from what your business actually offers.
  • No made-up answers: if the answer is not in your knowledge base, Sacha does not invent it. She says a member of your team will confirm, and passes the lead on.
  • One knowledge base for every channel: the same information on your website, on WhatsApp and on the phone.
  • Always up to date: update your knowledge base, and Sacha answers with the new information.

Why RAG is essential for your website and your online store: your visitors ask precise questions about your products, your services, delivery, returns or how to order. A generic AI chatbot guesses. Sacha answers from your own pages and documents, so every answer is right, the visitor trusts you, and the question becomes a qualified lead or a sale instead of a lost visit.

Free white paper: “How Agentic AI and RAG Are Entering the Enterprise Right Now”

Agentic AI and RAG, explained to a business owner. 144 pages, written by the founder of Sacha Omon AI, 2026 international edition. Data as of August 19, 2026, every source referenced in the appendix.

  • Why now: what changed in eighteen months
  • How it works: agentic AI explained without the jargon
  • The playbook: what to prepare before you roll out
  • What an agentic AI agent does, and what it doesn’t

Read it here: https://sacha-omon.app/en/white-paper?de=wordpress

What Sacha does

  • One agentic AI SDR on your website, WhatsApp and phone
  • Answers every lead in real time: in writing in 40+ languages, and by voice
  • Gives the right information about your products and services
  • Qualifies every lead, sorts the requests and books meetings with your sales team
  • No code: build it in 10 minutes just by talking

Why Sacha

No code: with Sacha Omon Builder, you answer a few questions out loud, and Sacha builds your agentic AI agent and goes live on your site in 10 minutes.

You invest in inbound and outbound marketing to bring in leads. At 8 pm, on weekends or while your team is in meetings, they land on a form and nobody answers. They buy from the competitor who answers first.

Sacha Omon AI is your agentic AI SDR. It answers in real time on your website, WhatsApp and the phone, in writing in 40+ languages (website chat and WhatsApp messages) and by voice. It qualifies every lead and sends them to your dashboard: who to call first, with meetings already booked. It joins your sales team and syncs with your CRM.

You answer before your competitors, every marketing dollar works harder, and your field team focuses on closing. Solo business, SMB or enterprise: your sales force is operational 24/7.

Built by an entrepreneur, for entrepreneurs: to solve our own problems and grow sales. Simple, useful, pragmatic.

Sacha Omon AI: We Sell For You.

Start your free 14-day trial at sacha-omon.app.

The plugin

This plugin connects your WordPress site to your Sacha:

  • Your Sacha on every page: paste your Sacha address once, and Sacha shows up on your whole site.
  • Elementor widget: drag the “Sacha Omon AI” widget anywhere to add a “Talk to Sacha” button. Works with the free Elementor.
  • Block and shortcode: the “Sacha Omon AI button” block, or [sacha_omon_ai] (with an optional texte="..." for your own button text).
  • Written answers in more than 40 languages: Sacha answers each visitor in their own language. The plugin’s own screens are in English.

Sacha Omon AI is a hosted service and needs a Sacha Omon AI account. Plans: https://sacha-omon.app/en/pricing?de=wordpress

External services

This plugin connects your site to Sacha Omon AI, the service that runs your Sacha (https://sacha-omon.app/?de=wordpress). Nothing is sent before you save your Sacha address, or before you click “Listen to Sacha” on the settings screen (below).

  • When you save your Sacha address: the plugin requests https://<your-name>.sacha-omon.app/w/<your-name>.js once, from your server, to check that this Sacha exists. Only the address you typed is used.
  • On every page of your site, once the address is saved: your visitors’ browsers load that same script from Sacha Omon AI. It shows the Sacha chat window. What a visitor types or says in that window is sent to Sacha Omon AI, which answers them, qualifies the request and can book a meeting. The plugin itself stores only your Sacha address and sends no data of its own.
  • On the Settings > Sacha Omon AI screen (administrators only): the screen shows a picture of Sacha that ships with the plugin. The short video of Sacha (https://app.sacha-omon.app/sacha-inscription-en.mp4) is loaded from Sacha Omon AI only when you click “Listen to Sacha”, and then plays with sound. Like any media file, loading it sends your browser’s address and usual request headers to Sacha Omon AI. Nothing is loaded on your public pages before you save your Sacha address.
  • The buttons (Elementor widget, block, shortcode) open that same window. They show “Loading…” until the window is ready.
  • What is kept in the visitor’s browser: the widget stores a few items in the visitor’s browser: in localStorage, whether the visitor accepted the consent boxes and the voice setting; in sessionStorage (cleared when the tab is closed), whether the window or welcome bubble was opened or closed, and where the visit came from (referring page, landing page and campaign parameters of the address, such as utm_* and ad click identifiers gclid, fbclid, msclkid), used to tell the business where the lead came from. No conversation is stored there. No name or email is stored there.

Sacha Omon AI terms: https://sacha-omon.app/en/terms?de=wordpress
Sacha Omon AI privacy policy: https://sacha-omon.app/en/privacy?de=wordpress
sections.installation:
How to install in 10 minutes

  1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New, search for Sacha Omon AI, then click Install Now and Activate.
  2. Go to Settings > Sacha Omon AI.
  3. No Sacha yet? Click the main button and talk with Sacha: she builds your agent with you in about 10 minutes, from your business and a few answers.
  4. Copy your Sacha address from your dashboard (it looks like https://your-company.sacha-omon.app).
  5. Back in Settings > Sacha Omon AI, click I already have my Sacha, paste the address and click Add Sacha to my site. Sacha is now live on every page.
  6. Optional: add a “Talk to Sacha” button with the Elementor widget, the block or the shortcode.
sections.faq:
What is an agentic AI SDR?

An SDR (sales development representative) answers, qualifies and follows up leads before your sales team closes. Sacha is an agentic AI SDR: she does not only chat, she reasons, decides and acts for your business, from your own information (RAG), and books the meeting.

What is RAG, and why does it matter for my website or online store?

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) means Sacha looks up your own knowledge base (your website, your products and services, your FAQ and your documents) before she answers. Your visitors get the right answer about your products, delivery, returns or how to order, not a generic AI guess. If the answer is not in your knowledge base, Sacha does not invent it: she says a member of your team will confirm, and passes the lead on. To learn more, read our white paper: https://sacha-omon.app/en/white-paper?de=wordpress

Which channels does Sacha cover?

Your website, WhatsApp and the phone, with one shared memory and one dashboard. The channels included depend on your plan (see the Plans link above).

Does Sacha answer in my visitors’ language?

Yes. In writing, Sacha answers each visitor in their own language, in more than 40 languages.

Do I need to write a script or train the AI?

No. You talk with Sacha for about 10 minutes and she builds your agent from your business. She answers from your own products and services.

Can a human take over?

Yes. Sacha hands the conversation over to your team when needed, and shows on the dashboard who to call first.

Do I need Elementor?

No. The plugin works on any WordPress site. With Elementor, you also get the “Sacha Omon AI” widget.

Where do I find my Sacha address?

In your Sacha dashboard. It always looks like https://your-company.sacha-omon.app.

How do I remove Sacha from my site?

Go to Settings > Sacha Omon AI, open Change the address and click Remove Sacha from my site, or deactivate the plugin.

Who do I contact for help?

Email sacha@sacha-omon.com.
